dataFlow.step: User submits name, email, phone at signup
email + name sent to api.postmarkapp.com via sendWelcomeEmail
User submits email at login, phone retrieved from DB; phone sent to api.twilio.com via sendVerificationSms
Nightly job: email of opted-in users sent to api.mailchimp.com via subscribeMember
Nightly job: sha256(phone) of all non-deleted users sent to graph.facebook.com via uploadPhoneAudience
Booking: sha256(userId) sent to graph.facebook.com via sendScheduleEvent; no raw email/phone/name included
Payment: card number sent to api.stripe.com via createPaymentMethod; no email/phone/name included
